{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent history shows mean reversion toward lower levels and sentiment is bearish.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, even if price is rising.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast, reduce next forecast by 5-10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending down, reduce forecast slope to avoid overcorrection.",
    "If forecast consistently overestimates true price, apply a 3-5% downward adjustment for the next 3 days.",
    "For sentiment-neutral periods, use 30-day moving average as a baseline to avoid overfitting to recent volatility."
  ]
}
